notes: Libretto by Lorenzo Da Ponte (1787). Words follow the Schirmer vocal score's spelling and punctuation, and its repeats of words and lines. Leporello sings his own four lines (Mille torbidi pensieri / mi s'aggiran per la testa: / se mi salvo in tal tempesta, / è un prodigio in verità!) against the other five's (Mille torbidi pensieri / mi s'aggiran per la testa. / Che giornata, o stelle, è questa! / Che impensata novità!). Kept as printed: Elvira's "Mille, mille" (bar 54) and Zerlina's lower-case "mille" (bar 56); "novita" without its accent once for Elvira (bar 103, "-ta," in bar 105) and once for Zerlina (bar 53, "-ta!" in bar 54), written as printed because the importer matches letters (sung novità); elisions as the print sets them ("salvo‿in" in some bars, "salvo in" on separate notes in others; in bar 76 "in" and "ve-" share a note). The piece is the Molto allegro of No. 19, from the top of page 200 to the double bar at the end of the number; it follows "Sola, sola in bujo loco". IPA, word meanings and translations were drafted for this app (S44) and the IPA was checked against Castel. IPA follows sung Italian conventions: stressed syllable marked, elisions (two words on one note in the score) joined with ‿, open e/o as ɛ/ɔ. Translation literal, for meaning.
